title: PR 185 MERGED a1e0c4f8 — no-unbounded-host-load rule LIVE on main (owner max-severity directive discharged); PR 186 (team-opener generalisation exploration plan) OPEN
body: PR 185 merged after three-loop verification (7/7, CLEAN, 7 review threads adjudicated first-hand across two waves — all VALID, all fixed: substring-mode trips whitespace-tolerant + proven against the founding DOS command verbatim, macOS perl-alarm timeout substitute, actionable host-health snippet, non-empty pattern schema, honest concept enumeration). The owner's maximum-severity never-again directive is now mechanism, not prose: a blocking innate-immunity tripwire + the canonical rule (in-process-first, bounded-owned-reaped) + start-right host-health check + the ops report's drain-timeout root-cause corrected. PR 186 OPEN: the owner-directed team-opener generalisation EXPLORATION plan (names the decision, makes none; owner walk at x5). Both deltas handed to Thermal's consolidation lane (e17324ff). Director queue now: the agent-tools lanes from Pearly's curation (control-byte/relative-path/prefix-resolution) + the watcher-non-exit fix the zombie audit surfaced + comms-store scalability — all routed, owner-gated walk pending in Thermal's session.
